title: Briefings & work-report preparation
description: Prepare morning briefings and weekly work-report drafts so useful context is ready for me to review. The assistant prepares the material; I check and decide what to share.

title: Sprint-change summaries
description: Turn daily sprint changes into concise team-update drafts, reducing repeated preparation while keeping the update grounded in actual changes.

title: First-pass pull request review
description: Scan for potential review findings, track duplicates, and clearly mark AI-generated comments. This supports my review; it does not replace final approval.

title: Incident-research assistance
description: Prepare research briefs that separate verified facts, inferences, and open questions. The workflow helps engineers gather context, not autonomously mitigate incidents.

title: Time-zone-aware partner follow-ups
description: Prepare follow-ups and collect bounded responses for cross-team coordination, with attention to partner time zones and my oversight of the communication.
